description: Statistics for an AskOnce board: total questions asked, unique questions after merging duplicates, duplicates merged and votes.

configuration.query: FROM questions | WHERE board == ?board | STATS questions = SUM(asks), unique_questions = COUNT(*), votes = SUM(votes), busiest = MAX(asks) | EVAL duplicates_merged = questions - unique_questions

board.description: AskOnce board name, for example demo-k8s-talk
